audit.summary: Archived assessment: Minor. The infinite-rank quasi-coherent extension lacks geometric PD coefficient convergence; The geometric zeroth face has an incorrect reference subscript; Cohomological construction has inconsistent differential-base and face normalizations
limitations: P1 — The infinite-rank quasi-coherent extension lacks geometric PD coefficient convergence — Counterevidence: Finite rank forces jointly nilpotent Higgs operators and restores the convergence reduction.

P1 — The infinite-rank quasi-coherent extension lacks geometric PD coefficient convergence — Counterevidence: The remark literally says R-module; the report explicitly tests the intended integral R+-module extension. It does not claim its H satisfies the literal inverted-p R-module wording. Finite rank restores joint nilpotence.
P2 — The geometric zeroth face has an incorrect reference subscript — Counterevidence: Correct absolute formula and subsequent calculation already use Y1.
P2 — The geometric zeroth face has an incorrect reference subscript — Counterevidence: The absolute formula (4.4) already uses Y_(j+1)-Y1 and the inverse ratio still reduces to1 modulo E.

P3 — Cohomological construction has inconsistent differential-base and face normalizations — Counterevidence: Adjacent proof and later degree-q expression use the corrected direct factor; no cohomology theorem counterexample established.

P3 — Cohomological construction has inconsistent differential-base and face normalizations — Counterevidence: C is actually defined using the left expression with base forms. The neighboring chain-map proof explicitly uses E->bE and b^(-phi/a-1); later degree-q uses b^(-phi/a-q). Positive-face definitions and final map are identity, so the spurious factors occur only in intermediate copied lines.
P4 — A finite orbit set is not the finite-vector notion in the Sen equality — Counterevidence: The corrected decompletion result is not refuted.

P4 — A finite orbit set is not the finite-vector notion in the Sen equality — Counterevidence: The correct finite-dimensional orbit-span/decompleted-module result is not refuted; no claim that the entire literal Wfin vanishes is needed.

P5 — Arithmetic Higgs commutator sign conflicts with its diagrams and functor — Counterevidence: This explicit correction aligns the Tate(-1) shift and intended comparison; no main theorem counterexample.

P5 — Arithmetic Higgs commutator sign conflicts with its diagrams and functor — Counterevidence: Both diagrams, Construction7.23, the actual Sen calculation7.13 and the comparison7.24 agree with the positive sign. The auxiliary checked the main full-faithfulness dependence and found no use of the negative equation; root verified the specified constructions and local algebra.
P6 — The analytic coordinate derivative omits the factor alpha — Counterevidence: The constant-kernel conclusion of Proposition7.9 is preserved.

P6 — The analytic coordinate derivative omits the factor alpha — Counterevidence: tau(alpha)=alpha+1 implies alpha!=0. Thus nabla_gamma=-alpha nabla_tau has the same kernel; locally restricting the analytic neighborhood preserves invertibility and the constant-coefficient conclusion.
Limitations: Author v4 is not verified equivalent to publisher VOR.
Limitations: Full text read does not independently reconstruct every Tate-Sen, prismatic descent, PD homotopy, derived annihilator or analytic acyclicity dependency.
Limitations: Lemma2.21 finite étale covering terminology was not resolved and is not an established Problem.
Limitations: Bounded search found no correction or executable supplement for exact paper; absent code is not a mathematical defect.
Limitations: Old arxiv2112.10140 gap notice belongs to a different preprint; target cites2311.07024.

Limitations: Exact per-image timestamps not separately captured and not reconstructed.
